text:
Priya (PM): quick sync  we need a concise decision on reserve-quota semantics for the next dedicated roadmap milestone. customers keep asking for predictable burst and clearer caps.
Leo (Eng): can we scope this to two concrete knobs? 1) reserved_quota (hard commit) and 2) burst_allowance (timeboxed soft buffer). keep cross-pool spillover off for MVP.
Tom (Sales): customers want the ability to purchase a small burst allowance on top of reserve for events. it's a paid add-on. they also asked for an admin 'block spillover' toggle.
Rashida (SRE): ops view: if burst_allowance is timeboxed, we need a deterministic expiration and automated reclaim. propose TTL window + background reclaim job.
Yara (Data): analytics ask: we need per-tenant time series for reserved vs burst consumption at 1m granularity for billing and anomaly detection.
Priya (PM): proposal: MVP features = a) reserve_quota (monthly commit), b) burst_allowance (90-minute windows purchasable or one-off), c) admin-level spillover control (on/off), d) billing export columns and dashboard.
Leo (Eng): API sketch:
```
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/capacity
{
  "reserved_quota": 2000000,            # tokens/month
  "burst_allowance": {"tokens": 500000, "window_min": 90},
  "spillover": "disabled"              # disabled | same-tier | permissive
}
```
Rashida (SRE): operational controls: add a short-circuit action "revoke_burst" in console for emergencies. and a circuit-breaker per-node to avoid noisy-tenant thrash.
Tom (Sales): commercial constraint: if burst consumption exceeds allowance during a contracted event, customers prefer automatic billing (pay-as-you-go) vs immediate throttling. need config flag.
Priya (PM): decision point: enforce hard cap (throttle) when both reserved_quota + burst_allowance are exhausted OR allow pay-as-you-go if customer opts-in. which default?
Yara (Data): default to throttle for GA; we can allow pay-as-you-go opt-in per tenant later. throttle gives predictable accounting for infra.
Rashida (SRE): +1 throttle default. pay-as-you-go adds billing and abuse complexity.
Leo (Eng): implementation note: admission path will check remaining_reserved + remaining_burst before routing to burst pool. token accounting must be atomic; will add DB row lock on tenant ledger.
Priya (PM): launch criteria checklist: 1) API + console controls, 2) billing export with fields [reserved_used, burst_used, burst_window_id], 3) dashboard panel, 4) revoke_burst console action, 5) e2e SLO flood/replay tests.
Tom (Sales): also need sample contract language for burst windows and example invoice line items. i'll draft.
Yara (Data): acceptance tests: simulate overlapping burst windows across tenants and validate reclaim and billing assignment.
rfc-bot: opened RFC DCR-4998: "reserve_quota + burst_allowance MVP (throttle default)" linking design doc.
Priya (PM): next steps: Leo and Rashida to break into tasks for sprint planning. Tom + Yara to prepare comms and tests. reconvene post-planning. :rocket:
